symptom: `create or modify java action` (and describe → exec of one) turns a Studio Pro action's ExportLevel Hidden into Public and blanks ActionDefaultReturnName ('ReturnValueName' → ''). Same ExportLevel hardcode on JavaScript actions
cause: execCreateJavaAction and execCreateJavaScriptAction built the action with ExportLevel: "Public" (and the Java path with no return name) on BOTH create and modify. Neither property has an MDL spelling — describe prints them as comments at most
insight: The hardcode was not merely a lost carry: "Public" is not a member of JavaActionsExportLevel or JavaScriptActionsExportLevel (both API | Hidden), so every action mxcli ever CREATED carried an enum value the metamodel does not declare. Check a hardcoded enum literal against generated/metamodel/enums.go before asking whether it should be carried — the create path is usually wrong too. Studio Pro's values for a new action, measured on all 69 in the Blank template: Hidden, ReturnValueName
